run_diffusers_cli: run the diffusers-cli tool with a subcommand and its arguments
run_environment_command: run the diffusers-cli environment command to display environment information
run_fp16_safetensors_command: run the diffusers-cli fp16 safetensors command to convert model weights
run_custom_blocks_command: run the diffusers-cli custom blocks command to manage custom model blocks
register_subcommand: register a new command class as a subparser on the diffusers-cli argument parser
